title: Lunch is on from Tuesday 1 September
preheader: Tuesday to Friday, 12pm to 3pm. Good food, good company and a proper midday break.

image.alt: Fish and chips with peas, tartare sauce and a glass of white wine, on a wooden table in the garden in the sunshine

data.placeholder_caption: Fish and chips in the garden, sunshine
data.headline: Lunch is on, Tuesday to Friday
body: It all starts on Tuesday 1 September. We're open from 12pm right through to 10pm, Tuesday to Friday, with the kitchen serving lunch from 12pm to 3pm and dinner from 4pm to 9pm. Come and take an hour back: a proper plate of food, something good to drink and a little time to enjoy it.

data.heading: Your new Tuesday to Friday
data.note: Last orders are 2.30pm at lunch and 8.30pm in the evening. Everything else stays just as you know it, and Mondays we're open from 4pm for drinks.

data.heading: And this is just the start
body: The full food menu is on from midday from day one, so there is already plenty to choose from. Over the coming weeks we'll be adding a few new lunchtime favourites and some offers to go with them, and you'll find all the details in the pub at lunchtimes.

data.heading: Easy to get here. Easy to stay a while.
data.body: Pull off the motorway, park right outside and take your time over lunch. And if you are after somewhere to work for a few hours, the dining room is a good spot: a power point at every table and superfast broadband throughout.

items.text: at every table in the dining room
for when the sun is out

data.heading: Make a little more of lunchtime
data.body: Whether it's fish and chips in the sunshine, a quick bite with someone from work, or a long overdue catch-up over a proper meal, come and spend it with us. Good food, something nice to drink and plenty of time to enjoy both.
Book a table for lunch or simply walk in. From Tuesday 1 September, we'll be here from midday and ready to welcome you.
reassurance_items: Book ahead or just pop in

data.ps_body: If the sun is shining, there is always the garden. Lunch tastes even better outside.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you told us you were happy to hear from us. Our list goes back a long way, so that may have been a while ago.
